profile.description: Generate videos with effects like squishing an object, two people hugging, making heart gestures, etc. using Kling-Pro-Effects. Requires an image input. Send a single image for `squish` and `expansion` effects and two images (of people) for `hug`, `kiss`, and `heart_gesture` effects. Set effect with --effect. Default effect: `squish`. Set duration with `--duration` with either 5s or 10s, set to 5s by default.
